facts.fact: The DGSSI register of regulated services, applying Articles 8, 17, 46, 52 and 53 of Loi 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions, treats the law as operating; the page has no date, so its published date of 2026-09-03 is used.
facts.system: Loi n° 43-20 relative aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques

facts.fact: The page cites Decree n° 2-22-687 made to apply Law 43-20, which sets transitional periods running from 13 July 2023 (Article 33: six months for non-qualified trust service providers) and lists exempt cryptology means in its annex 6; the same date starts the one-year period under Article 80 of the law for providers approved under Law 53-05.
facts.system: Décret n° 2-22-687 pris pour l'application de la loi n° 43-20

facts.fact: Under Article 53 of Law 43-20 the DGSSI publishes its list of approved trust service providers, which names three: EURAFRIC INFORMATION (AfricTRUST, CertiSign+ and CertiSeal+), Barid Al Maghrib (Classe 3 signature and seal, qualified timestamp) and DamaneSign (qualified signature and seal), all at the qualified level; the page has no date, so its published date of 2026-09-03 is used.
facts.system: DGSSI list of approved trust service providers (PSCo)

facts.fact: The DGSSI lists the conformity certificates it issued under Articles 8 and 17 of Law 43-20 for qualified signature and seal creation devices: six current ones from CC-1/2024 (25 April 2024) to CC-1/2026 (18 March 2026), the latest being an Entrust nShield module.
facts.system: DGSSI qualified signature and seal creation device certificates (QSCD)

facts.fact: The DGSSI publishes a list of trust service providers that made the prior declaration required by Article 53 of Law 43-20, naming DamaneSign, Lleida Networks, LRE Trust, EURAFRIC INFORMATION, Lex Persona, Banque Centrale Populaire (Chaabi eSign), Adria Digitrust, Barid Al Maghrib, Barid Media and SAFY.io; the page has no date, so its published date of 2026-09-03 is used.
facts.system: DGSSI list of trust service providers with prior declaration

facts.fact: The page records that the approvals of Barid Al-Maghrib (n°2/PSCE/2022) and EURAFRIC INFORMATION (n°1/PSCE/2022) under the earlier Law 53-05 expired on 14 July 2024, and that the 53-05 providers had one year from 13 July 2023 to comply with Law 43-20.
facts.system: Approvals of certification service providers under Law 53-05

systems.system: Barid eSign (Classe 3 signature and seal, qualified timestamp)
